slices.title: model-gateway: images as parts, remove the diversion, client catalogue gate (code half)
slices.summary: Behind CHAT_VISION_AS_PARTS_ENABLED (default off), an Ask turn with images goes to the picked vision-capable model with the images as image_parts on every tool round, instead of the vision-only AnalyzeImage diversion that drops history, tools and memory. Do turns with images are refused until S6, and the client gates image attachment by the model's declared vision capability.
slices.remaining: Code half: model-gateway images as parts, removal of the diversion, client changes, with tests.
